scope: Research training and exposed development evaluation, not independent Gold or final Test
current_reference: Keep the existing Issue-29 model and its 12516-row training history unchanged
comparisons: Frozen Issue-29 reference on the same new development population
wiki_small versus wiki_large: nested source population, identical adaptation procedure and fixed update budget
wiki_large versus mixed: equal row count, identical extraction/label rules and update budget; source composition changes

jawiki.page_selection: SHA256 canonical JSON [seed, jawiki, page_id, sample] modulo 100 is zero; decide before cleaning or target extraction
jawiki.target_selection: Lowest SHA256 keys within each complete page, never the first eight textual matches
jawiki.cleaner: Existing conservative cleaner plus versioned left-context/target quality quarantine

aozora.eligibility: Exactly one metadata row per work, author role only, work and person copyright flags both nashi, shinji-shinkana, NDC 913 or 914, official HTTPS text ZIP URL
aozora.selection: Lowest SHA256 [seed, aozora, work_id, select] within the fixed author partition and author cap
aozora.failure_policy: Retain selected failed/missing works and reasons; no adaptive replacements; rate limit stops acquisition for later bounded resume

labels.reading: Exact unique dictionary reading, unchanged dictionary hash; no guessed or AI-certified readings
labels.targets: Same longest dictionary-surface matching and bounded context policy for both sources
labels.context: At most 64 preceding characters in the cleaned source paragraph; synthetic replay, not observed Sakura user-session text
labels.normalization: Exact Unicode surface equality; no global spelling normalization
labels.candidate_source: Separately bound research reference identity b12db1c5ab5b0c0ca1337665ec654bf784b1b645
labels.training_eligibility: Exactly one source-exact target in Top-6, complete system-dictionary path, at least two candidates; preserve all other outcomes in the acquisition report
labels.evaluation_eligibility: All fixed source targets, including Top-6 misses, empty/failed outputs and unresolved execution; no oracle-based evaluation selection

isolation.partition: SHA256 [seed, corpus, source_group, partition] modulo 10: 0-1 development evaluation, 2-9 training
isolation.historical_sources: Authenticate all six previous jawiki source-span generations; exclude their articles before new extraction and their exact/near-duplicate content from all new populations
isolation.cross_partition_component: Quarantine the entire component, never move evaluation members into training
isolation.old_holdout: Hash/source-metadata isolation only; do not parse labels/candidates or train on old evaluation rows

training.status: Freeze exact input hashes and execution recipe before model fitting; no model fitting in source preparation
training.matched_controls: Same initialization, loss, features, optimizer and update/token budget across all three new-data arms; preserve frozen Issue-29 reference separately

expected_effect: Test whether sample count and source diversity improve generalization; no assumed accuracy gain or release eligibility
